rules_summary: Initially equal weight constituents at each quarterly rebalance.
Maximum weight is determined using a single-stock cap, trading liquidity and float-adjusted market capitalization relative to theoretical portfolio value.
Reduce constrained constituents and iteratively redistribute excess weight to uncapped constituents.
Rebalances occur in March, June, September and December; prices can cause weights to drift between rebalances.
clarification: Equal weighting refers to portfolio value, not share count. KRE is modified equal weighted, so holdings do not all have identical weights. Weight limits do not represent a credit-quality assessment.
